prompt: Which statements about branches are true? Choose all that apply.
explanation: Branches are lightweight labels that keep parallel lines of work separate — creatable locally in Git or on GitHub. No folder duplication happens; Git tracks lines of commits, not copies of files.

options.text: A branch is a movable label pointing at a line of commits
Branches let several people work without stepping on each other
By convention the default branch is called `main`
A branch physically duplicates the repository folder on disk
Branches can only be created on the GitHub website
